name: zclass_list_delete_node_from_lists
description: zClass_List::DeleteNodeFromLists marks a node for removal from its type/action/display buckets and returns success.
known_limits: Functional acceptance covers the normal class/action bucket removal path. tier S verification is deferred to the coherent zClass list/free-list pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x44f000 validates class-id dispatch to MarkPendingRemoval buckets, optional action-callback priority removal, and final type-list bucket 6 removal before returning zero.
The native smoke verifies class/action/type list pending-removal flags, pending links, and ProcessDeferredWork cleanup for a representative node.
